kp6:1.2:
antalikkhe → antaḷikkhe (bj) | antaḷikkhe → yānīha bhūtāni samāgatāni
bhūmyāni vā yāni vā antarīkṣe
sarvāṇi vā āttamanāti bhūtvā
śrūṇvantu svasatyayanaṁ jinena bhāṣitam (bj: mahāvastu) | bhummāni → bhūmāni (cck: ka.)
kp6:3.1:
vā → imasmiṁ loke parasmiṁ vā puna:
savēṣu vā yadātanaṁ praṇitam
na tatsamaṁ asati tathāgatena
devātidevena narottamena
idampi buddhe ratanaṁ paṇītaṁ
etena satyena susvasti hotu (bj: mahāvastu)
kp6:5.1:
yaṁ buddhaseṭṭho → yambuddhaseṭṭho (bj, sya-all) | suciṁ → yambuddhaśreṣṭho parivarṇayet śuciṁ
yamāhu ānantarikaṁ samādhiṁ
samādhino tasya samo na vidyāte
idampi dhamē ratanaṁ praṇītaṁ
etena satyena susvasti hotu (bj: mahāvastu)
kp6:6.1: aṭṭha sataṁ pasatthā → aṭṭhasatampasatthā (bj); aṭṭhasataṁ pasaṭṭhā (sya-all)
kp6:6.6:
hotu → ye pudgalā aṣṭa sadā praśastā
catvāri etāni yugāni honti
te dakṣīṇeyā sugatena uktā
eteṣu dinnāni mahatphalāni
idampi saṅghe ratnaṁ praṇitaṁ
etena (bj: mahāvastu)
kp6:7.6:
hotu → ye yuktayogī manasā suchandasā
ṇaiṣakāmayino gotamaśāsanasmin
te prāptiprāptā amātaṁ ‘vagāhya
vimuktavittā nirvṛtiṁ bhuṁjamānāඃ
idampi saṁghe (bj: mahāvastu)
kp6:8.1: pathavissito → paṭhaviṁsito (bj); paṭhaviṁ sito (sya-all) | pathavissito → paṭhavissito (cck: ka. sī.); pathaviṁsito (cck: ka. si. syā. kaṁ. pī.)
kp6:8.6:
hotu → yathendrakīlo pṛthiviśrito syā-
cavaturhi vātehi asamprakampī
tathopamaṁ satpuruṣaṁ vademi
yo āryasatyāni sudeśitāni
gambhīraaṭāni avetya paśyati
idampi (bj: mahāvastu)
kp6:9.6:
hotu → ye āryasatyāni vibhāvayanti
gambhīraprajñena sudeśitāni
kiñcāpi te honti bhāśaṁ pramattā
na te bhavānaṣṭa upādiyanti
idampi saṅghe (bj: mahāvastu)
kp6:11.2: chaccābhiṭhānāni abhabba → cha cābhiṭhānāni abhabbo (bj, sya-all) | chaccābhiṭhānāni → cha cābhiṭhānāni (cck: sī. syā.) | kātuṁ → abhabbo kātuṁ (cck: sī.)
kp6:11.4:
hotu → sahaiva yasya darśanasampadāya.
trayosya dharmā jahitā bhavanti
satkāyadṛṣṭiṁ vicikitsitaṁ ca
śīlavrataṁ vāpi yadasti kiñvīt
idampi saṅghe (bj: mahāvastu)
kp6:12.1: kamma → kammaṁ (bj, sya-all) | kamma → kammaṁ (cck: sī. syā. kaṁ. pī.)
kp6:12.3: abhabba → abhabbo (bj, sya-all) | paṭicchadāya → paṭicchādāya (bj) | Abhabba → abhabbo (cck: bahūsu) | paṭicchadāya → paṭicchādāya (cck: sī.)
kp6:12.6:
hotu → kiñcāpi śaikṣo prakaroti pāpaṁ
kāyena vācā atha cetasāpi
abhavyo so tasya niguhanāya
abhavyatā dṛṣṭipatheṣu uktā
idampi saṅghe (bj: mahāvastu)
kp6:13.1: yatha → yathā (bj, sya-all) | yatha → yathā (cck: sī. syā.)
kp6:13.3: adesayi nibbānagāmiṁ → adesayī nibbāṇagāmiṁ (bj) | adesayi → adesayī (cck: sī.)
kp6:13.6:
hotu → vane pragūlamā yatha puṣpitāgrā
grīsmāṇamāse prathame caitrasmin
vāteritā te surabhiṁ pravānti
evaṁvidhā dhyāyino buddhaputrāඃ
śīlenupetā surabhiṁ pravānti
idampi saṅghe (bj: mahāvastu)
kp6:15.4: yathāyaṁ padīpo → yathāyampadīpo (bj, sya-all) | yathāyaṁ → yathayaṁ (cck: ka.)
kp6:15.6:
hotu → kṣīṇaṁ purāṇaṁ navo nāsti saṁcayo
vimuktavittā āyatike bhavasmin 
te kṣīṇabījā avirūḍhidharmā
nirvānti dhīrā yathā tailadīpāඃ
idampi saṅghe ratanaṁ praṇītaṁ
etena saccena susvasti hotu (bj: mahāvastu)
kp6:16.4:
hotu → vipaśyismiṁ viścabhuvikrakucchande 
bhāmakanakamunismiṁ kāśyape 
mahāyaśe śākyamunismi gautame 
eteṣu buddheṣu mahardhikeṣu 
yā devatā satti abhiprasannā 
vāḍhampi tā rakṣantu ca karontu 

svasatyayanaṁ mānuṣiyā prajāye
yo dharmacakraṁ ahibhūya lokaṁ
pravartayati sarvabhūtānukampī
etādāśaṁ devamanuṣyaśreṣṭhaṁ
buddhaṁ namasyāma susvasti hotu.
dharmaṁ namasyāma susvasti hotu. 
saṅghaṁ namasyāma susvasti hotu (bj note)
